text:
maria: Seeing a spike of missing node_exporter proc metrics + DCGM temp gaps on gpu-pool in us-west-2. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/abcd/gpu-health?orgId=1
sre-oncall: alert node_exporter_proc_access firing for 5 hosts :rotating_light:
kyle: which hosts? can you paste a few pod logs?
maria: gpu-node-57, gpu-node-89, gpu-node-12 — node-exporter logs: "failed to open /proc/diskstats: permission denied"
rajeev: FYI we rolled an AMI bake last night that tightened proc permissions via tmpfiles (was to harden procfs). Could be the culprit.
anya: if /proc is mounted with hidepid=2 node_exporter can't read other pids, but diskstats should still be readable. weird.
rajeev: DCGM sidecar also shows TLS handshake timeouts around same time — suspect time skew (we saw NTP drift on those hosts after the AMI changed systemd-timesyncd config)
kyle: so two issues: proc hidepid and NTP drift. nice.
maria: can we quick-fix via daemonset patch to add a privileged initContainer that remounts /proc without hidepid? example:
```yaml
initContainers:
- name: fix-proc-perms
  image: busybox
  command: ["/bin/sh","-c","mount -o remount,hidepid=0 /proc || true"]
  securityContext:
    privileged: true
  volumeMounts:
  - mountPath: /proc
    name: proc
volumes:
- name: proc
  hostPath:
    path: /proc
``` 
maria: this would require privileged init — ok for canary nodes only.
ops-bot: deploy-bot started canary update on gpu-metrics ds in us-west-2
sre-oncall: also increase prometheus scrape_timeout for node_exporter on gpu-pool to 5s, and set scrape_interval to 30s for those targets. current 10s/2s too tight.
anya: suggested prometheus config snippet:
```yaml
- job_name: 'node_exporter_gpu'
  scrape_interval: 30s
  scrape_timeout: 5s
  static_configs:
  - targets: ['<gpu-node-ip-list>']
``` 
kyle: let's also add a recording rule to ignore short-lived gaps to avoid paging the oncall: rule: increase alert_for to 10m for node_exporter_proc_access.
rajeev: long term: revert AMI tmpfiles change + fix timesyncd config. I'll start an AMI bake ticket.
maria: rolling the canary now: `kubectl rollout restart daemonset/gpu-metrics -n infra` — monitoring
sre-oncall: alert noise down to 2 hosts after canary, DCGM temp gaps resolved on the canary nodes :thumbsup:
ops-bot: canary passed — staging rollout scheduled in 30m
kyle: follow-up action items:
- rajeev: AMI revert + add test for hidepid in node e2e
- anya: prometheus scrape tuning PR
- maria: run post-deploy SLO check on gpu latency dashboard
rajeev: opened LU#4321 with AMI diff and timeline
maria: thanks everyone, keep eyes on grafana for next 2 hours
sre-oncall: ack
